title: Even More Advancements (EMA)
description:
This datapack aims to add many new advancements, challenges and goals to Minecraft.
This will be updated frequently, adding more advancements or fixing bugs.


Installation:

Put the downloaded ZIP into: %appdata%\.minecraft\saves\[yourworld]\datapacks.
body:
This is a datapack for Java Edition Minecraft versions 1.21.10 and up. 

This datapack adds many new advancements and challenges to Minecraft to spice up gameplay. 
This project is currently a big work-in-progress, but will be frequently recieve updates adding more advancements, challenges and maybe even goals to the game.
Have fun!
